name: XlSheetVisibility
description: Specifies whether the object is visible.

constants.name: xlSheetHidden
constants.description: Hides the worksheet which the user can unhide via menu.

constants.name: xlSheetVeryHidden
constants.description: Hides the object so that the only way for you to make it visible again is by setting this property to True (the user cannot make the object visible).
